name: licenkit
description: LicenKit - Modern, self-hosted API-First licensing hub and key generator
author: LicenKit Contributors

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && pnpm --filter @licenkit/cli run build && pnpm --filter @licenkit/admin run build && pnpm run build:site && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir apps/server/dist
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @licenkit/cli run typecheck && pnpm --filter @licenkit/admin run typecheck && pnpm --filter @licenkit/server run typecheck
scripts.test: node scripts/generate-schema-review.mjs --check && pnpm run test:site && pnpm --filter @licenkit/server run test && pnpm --filter @licenkit/cli run test && pnpm --filter @licenkit/admin run test
